fact: The health ministry's strategic plan, with a preface dated 8 February 2019 and drawn up from a 2018 assessment, states that health services are not computerised, that health-service records lack a single model and computerisation across all the country's health facilities, and that there is no unified, validated clinical history format.
title: Plan Estratégico de Fortalecimiento del Sistema Nacional de Información Sanitaria (PEFSNIS) 2019 - 2023
publisher: Ministerio de Sanidad y Bienestar Social (MINSABS)
